steps.meaning: St. Vincent regional hospital holds a specific number of usable blood units at the deadline of Friday July 24, 2026, 12:00 PM PDT.
steps.name: hospital_holds_units_at_deadline

steps.meaning: The hospital's stock at deadline equals its initial stock of 15 units plus any units received from shipments that arrive before the deadline.
steps.name: initial_stock_plus_shipments

steps.meaning: St. Vincent regional hospital held 15 usable units at 9:00 AM on Monday July 20, 2026.
steps.name: hospital_initial_stock

steps.meaning: All shipments dispatched from the centre on Tuesday and Thursday that arrive before the deadline are received by the hospital.
steps.name: shipments_received

steps.meaning: The centre dispatches 150 units on Tuesday July 21, 2026 at 4:00 PM PDT.
steps.name: tuesday_shipment_dispatched

steps.meaning: The centre dispatches 150 units on Thursday July 23, 2026 at 4:00 PM PDT.
steps.name: thursday_shipment_dispatched

steps.meaning: The centre has at least 150 usable units in stock at the time of Tuesday's dispatch (4:00 PM July 21).
steps.name: centre_has_enough_stock_tuesday

steps.meaning: The centre has at least 150 usable units in stock at the time of Thursday's dispatch (4:00 PM July 23).
steps.name: centre_has_enough_stock_thursday

steps.meaning: The centre held 40 usable units at 9:00 AM on Monday July 20, 2026.
steps.name: centre_initial_stock

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Monday July 20 from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PDT, collecting at 12 units per hour, adding 96 units to centre stock.
steps.name: monday_collection

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Tuesday July 21 from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM PDT (7 hours before dispatch), collecting at 12 units per hour, adding 84 units to centre stock.
steps.name: tuesday_collection_before_dispatch

steps.meaning: Centre stock after Tuesday dispatch equals previous stock minus 150 units dispatched.
steps.name: centre_stock_after_tuesday_dispatch

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Wednesday July 22 from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PDT, collecting at 12 units per hour, adding 96 units to centre stock.
steps.name: wednesday_collection

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Thursday July 23 from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM PDT (7 hours before dispatch), collecting at 12 units per hour, adding 84 units to centre stock.
steps.name: thursday_collection_before_dispatch

steps.meaning: Tuesday's shipment arrives at the hospital after 3 hours, at about 7:00 PM PDT on July 21.
steps.name: tuesday_shipment_arrives

steps.meaning: Thursday's shipment arrives at the hospital after 3 hours, at about 7:00 PM PDT on July 23.
steps.name: thursday_shipment_arrives
